body.x: Silvia Health participated in CES 2022, which was held in Las Vegas from January 5th to 7th, and introduced their cognitive health platform app "Silvia."
Founded in 2020, Silvia Health is an age-tech startup that solves aging problems with human-centered technology.

Ko Myung-jin, CEO of Silvia Health, grew up around grandmothers and grandfathers and witnessed various physical and psychological problems experienced by seniors in the aging process. Afterwards, he went on to attend medical school, where he further interacted with the elderly and realized the need for omnidirectional care in the daily life of the elderly.

Silvia Health, a healthcare startup that was founded from this opportunity, has managed to attract seed investment from Klimventures in August 2020, after its victory on the Demo Day co-hosted by Seoul National University Medical School X D Camp in 2019, and is growing rapidly after being selected by Samsung Electronic's C-LAB Outside Program in 2021 and winning the grand prize at the Jung Ju-Young Startup Contest in August of the same year.
Currently, Silvia Health has launched the "Silvia" app, a cognitive health platform aimed at early diagnosis and prevention of dementia.
An official from Silvia Health said, "Starting with 'Silvia', we want to become a leading company in customized cognitive health care in the digital healthcare market."

Silvia Health participated in CES 2022 as part of the Korea Health Industry Development Institute's (KHIDI) Startup Leap Package support project. The KHIDI Startup Center opened in March 2018 in order to encourage more startup and revitalize the ecosystem. Excellent ideas and technologies are discovered, and dedicated project managers (PMs) are deployed to provide support inprofessional consulting, technical evaluation, investment attraction, and market support.

Meanwhile, CES, the world's largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition where you can grasp the flow of the global home appliance industry at a glance. It is hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS, which has been covering CES for 16 consecutive years, has been sending the most news around the world every year since 2006, and will host 'Best of CES 2022' to select the best innovative products and technologies and 'BEST OF MADE IN KOREA' to select notable Korean companies. In addition, AVING LIVE, which conveys issues at the CES site, will be held for 7 days including Media Day.
